name: Have you assessed and managed the risks associated with any third-party development environments or software prior to committing to using them?
conditionsText:
Applies when using:
- GitHub
- GitLab
- CI/CD platforms
- Development frameworks
- Open-source libraries
- Code generation tools
requirementTitle: Have you assessed and managed the risks associated with any third-party development environments or software prior to committing to using them?
requirementDescription: Before using external development tools, frameworks, code repositories or software products, have you checked whether they introduce security risks?
why:
Development tools can create risks such as:
- Software supply-chain attacks
- Vulnerable dependencies
- Malicious code
- Insecure build pipelines
- Exposure of source code
